• EPACK (Credit Rating): Executive Summary: Epack Durable Limited Rating Update Crisil Ratings has reaffirmed Epack Durable Limited's (EDL) bank loan ratings at 'CRISIL A-/Stable/CRISIL A2+', acknowledging its established market position and healthy financial risk profile, including strong liquidity and improved gearing post-IPO. • FLEXITUFF (SAST): Flexituff Ventures International Limited has defaulted on a substantial debt of over INR 236 crores owed to a consortium of lenders, leading UCO Bank to take symbolic possession of a significant commercial property under the SARFAESI Act. • FORCEMOT (SAST): Force Motors Limited has announced a significant and simultaneous change in its senior management, with eleven officials ceasing to be part of the Senior Management Officials group effective July 29, 2026.
